units.title: Review and ratify the specification baseline
deliverables: Record retained user requirements, disagreements and baseline acceptance at a real Git revision.
Resolve or explicitly retain scoped open decisions; do not invent a license or safety approval.
Reconcile all supplied October/September proposals with scoped disposition, source hashes and independent current tooling results.
Fetch the requested AIDE dev pin without executing upstream scripts; record refresh policy and passive schema compatibility.
Address review R01-R05 with independent local regressions; record terminal/shell/output and icon-report disposition without claiming runtime or asset qualification.
Reconcile the latest CLI placement/help/shortcut proposal, retain unrun native parser expectations and validate descriptor consistency.
acceptance: Bootstrap and structural tests run with actual logs.
No product or hardware test reported as passed.
Owner-approved baseline or explicit changes/blockers recorded.

units.title: Build a minimal native single-entrypoint composition
deliverables: Native executable with build inspect and fake command discovery.
Exact current-Windows prototype toolchain/import declaration; inventory available XP tools but retain XP compile/launch as unverified DE-W018/031 work.
Use DE-014 for the bounded fake composition; full delivery/Setup design in DE-060 is deferred to DE-W060/062, not a native-slice prerequisite.
DE-079 execution contract, independent clean-checkout reproduction and needs-review evidence; human essential subset only.
acceptance: Clean native build log retained.
No provider opens physical devices.
Public basename is disked.
Essential build/help/command path opens no devices, initializes no optional providers and requires no network/Setup/elevation.
Retain exact native build/test commands, compiler/import closure and tested host; spec-only checks are insufficient.
Public full command contracts stay planned; composition discovery separates implemented human subset from unavailable planned commands.

units.title: Measure Windows launch and console ownership behavior
deliverables: Record Explorer/cmd/PowerShell/redirection/absent-handle behavior.
Decision DE-DEC-002 with subsystem alternatives and measured limitations.
acceptance: Caller-owned console never hidden/detached.
Explicit mode and conflict fixture parity.
No no-flash claim without observed evidence.

units.title: Implement descriptor-owned CLI and machine envelopes
deliverables: Registry-driven dispatch and help with planned commands unavailable.
Bounded JSON/NDJSON framing and typed errors.
acceptance: Duplicate keys/oversized requests rejected.
Machine stdout has only valid framed JSON.
Exit codes and no-prompt behavior tested.
Typed argument bindings and alias/canonical collision checks drive parser/help/completion; unavailable unresolved syntax cannot be advertised as implemented.
Strict producer and compatible-reader fixtures, operation/attempt/epoch identities and native exit/wait outcomes are defined before protocol admission.
Run the shared command-syntax corpus and option-placement metamorphic cases against the native parser; no pre-parse output, file creation, provider access or frontend initialization.

Complete typed operation parameter contracts before admitting unresolved commands. Validate exact option arity, reserved names, duplicate aliases, prefix/operand ambiguity, help-only requests and unchanged target/effect semantics.

units.title: Implement fake graph and frontend service
deliverables: Immutable snapshots and typed actions over deterministic fake targets.
Revision-conflict refusal and stable selection identity.
acceptance: No UI-specific safety logic.
Target removal cannot select another row implicitly.

units.title: Implement linear and full-screen TUI over fake state
deliverables: Same-binary TUI with linear accessible fallback and command explorer.
acceptance: All implemented fake actions available through TUI.
Small terminal and missing features degrade without losing semantic outcomes.

units.title: Implement minimal native Win32 GUI over fake state
deliverables: Native navigator/inspector/current-proposed view with structured equivalent.
acceptance: GUI initializes only when requested.
Keyboard and high-contrast checks recorded on actual tested host.
Parity transcript matches CLI and TUI.
Use original/licensed fixture artwork until source provenance and exact redistribution rights are evidenced; a supplied icon inspection report alone grants none.

units.title: Prove same-file process roles without privilege
deliverables: Unprivileged fake provider-host self-spawn and operation reconnect.
Threat-model findings for later elevation.
acceptance: No elevation or raw access.
Killed client leaves an inspectable honest fake operation outcome.

units.title: Implement portable checked arithmetic and extents
deliverables: Bounded views, endian helpers, checked u64 arithmetic and half-open extents.
acceptance: Overflow/underflow/device-end and nonstandard-unit tests pass.
No OS headers in portable code.

units.title: Implement bounded MBR and EBR readers
deliverables: Read-only MBR/EBR parser preserving opaque fields.
acceptance: Cycles, relative EBR bases, overlaps and truncated images covered.
Parser never writes or mounts an image.

units.title: Implement independent GPT readers and diagnostics
deliverables: Primary/backup validation with exact upstream format revision and bounded allocation.
acceptance: Valid-disagreeing copies not auto-repaired.
GUID/UTF16/endpoints and checksum vectors covered.

units.title: Build differential corpus and parser fault campaign
deliverables: Generated malformed-image corpus and reproducible external-oracle adapters.
acceptance: Disagreements retained rather than majority-voted away.
Exact tool versions/source identities recorded.

units.title: Expose read-only image inspection in all frontends
deliverables: Raw image capture and verification through shared actions.
acceptance: No host mounting or physical writes.
CLI/TUI/GUI fixtures produce equivalent diagnostics.

units.title: Implement native NT read-only inventory
deliverables: Read-only disk/volume/mount identity observations with explicit denial/unknown state.
acceptance: XP and modern import floors audited.
No deep test or elevation triggered by bare startup.
Duplicate identity and removal cases retained.

units.title: Qualify initial Windows target launch and frontend matrix
deliverables: Real launch logs for XP/7/10/11 artifacts and optional ARM64 lane.
acceptance: Untested targets remain planned.
Native GUI and redirected machine mode both exercised.

units.title: Add bounded health observations and redaction
deliverables: Admitted read-only observer adapters and explicit unavailable data.
acceptance: No health oracle implies safe media.
Deep/self-test actions are not auto-issued.

units.title: Implement resumable image acquisition against fixtures
deliverables: Bounded data pipeline, acquisition map and explicit substitution semantics.
acceptance: Source/destination alias and no-clobber protection tested.
Resume verifies identity and map; failing-media policy documented.
Typed source/destination/host resource bindings and epochs are checked independently before acquisition implementation claims.

units.title: Implement case evidence and reports
deliverables: Before/after capture, custody records, redacted support export.
acceptance: Actual facts separated from inference.
No secrets/customer filenames exported without policy.

units.title: Design and model runtime journal encoding
deliverables: Exact byte format and durability/failure model proposal.
Decision DE-DEC-004 with recovery and torn-write tests.
acceptance: No product writes while format is only proposed.
Checksum/record/flush/unknown-effect behavior fully specified.
Separate immutable plan definitions from review/approval/admission/execution receipts and define composable per-step recovery properties before a real writer.

units.title: Implement table mutation only in disposable images
deliverables: Image-only reviewed plans, bounded writers and independent verifier.
acceptance: Fault injection around every write/flush.
Unrelated bytes preserved and no raw devices accepted.

units.title: Exercise interrupted image recovery and cancellation
deliverables: Replay/resume/uncertain outcome test harness and recovery capsule fixtures.
acceptance: No false atomicity/rollback claims.
Unknown commit state requires recapture.

units.title: Design and qualify the elevated NT broker boundary
deliverables: Exact-image/IPC/approval design with security review.
Decision DE-DEC-005; no raw hardware execution under this WorkUnit.
acceptance: Swap/replay/spoofing/static-initializer concerns evaluated.
Any real elevation test needs a separate authorized lab procedure.

units.title: Prepare separately authorized physical qualification procedures
deliverables: Sacrificial-device procedures, input forms and required reviewers; no device commands executed.
acceptance: No production claim without actual independent hardware/recovery evidence.
Explicit permissions and scope for every subsequent lab run.

units.title: Pin and map Universal Setup package integration
deliverables: Exact source contract mapping and payload equality tests on fixture directories.
acceptance: No assumed unsupported Setup modes.
Occupied roots and customer evidence retention covered.

units.title: Verify AIDE WorkUnit export against pinned upstream
deliverables: Run actual pinned AIDE validation when authorized and accessible.
Record real round-trip results or blockers; update DE-DEC-007.
Review the pinned dev source about weekly until stable; preserve old/new identities and update sources, integration declaration and export-schema evidence atomically.
acceptance: Do not claim runtime scheduler/interoperability from shape matching.
Exports remain non-authorizing until an actual grant.

units.title: Inspect and design current JC-DOS/Carbon integration
deliverables: Pinned current ABI and filesystem source references; bounded adapter design only.
acceptance: No inherited ABI constants treated as verified.
No parallel hardware driver stack invented.

units.title: Prototype DOS and OS/2 read-only image profiles
deliverables: Native constrained image reader/terminal prototype with exact toolchains.
acceptance: Address/memory ceilings enforced.
No unsupported GUI or physical-write claim.

At parser admission, run the same shared syntax corpus for the selected DOS/OS2/Windows profile; record actual limits and unsupported cases without reassigning aliases. Early primitive probes may report native parser not_run.

units.title: Design advanced operation/provider admission slices
deliverables: Separate plans for each move/resize/boot/encryption/media family.
acceptance: No giant implement-everything task.
Each family has failure model, provider evidence and phase gates.

units.title: Ratify licensing and prepare read-only release criteria
deliverables: Owner license decision and exact clean dependency closure.
Read-only release checklist, not an automatic release.
acceptance: No false Microsoft/Sysinternals endorsement.
Actual target evidence accompanies support claims.
Portable read-only release has no mandatory Setup dependency; any claimed managed channel additionally needs DE-W060/062 acceptance and its exact ownership/carrier evidence.

units.title: Measure fake-provider resilience and resource bounds
deliverables: Run combined healthy/denied/malformed/slow/crashed provider campaign; select and measure per-host budgets.
acceptance: Unknown cancellation never becomes quiescence or an automatic writer retry.
Input latency, worker/retry/memory/event ceilings and retained observations have actual logs.
Guard logical operation, attempt, worker/capture epochs, effect certainty, cancellation and recovery independently; late events never transfer writer ownership.
Once DE-W019 is implemented, include its shell in frontend semantic/failure transcripts.

units.title: Run early constrained primitive and terminal probes
deliverables: Small 8086, Win16, Win9x and OS2 loader/arithmetic/text experiments with exact tools or explicit blockers.
acceptance: No device access; large addresses refuse or round-trip exactly.
Do not advertise terminal/piping/GUI behavior from an emulator compile or block the independent modern slice.

At parser admission, run the same shared syntax corpus for the selected DOS/OS2/Windows profile; record actual limits and unsupported cases without reassigning aliases. Early primitive probes may report native parser not_run.

units.title: Prototype optional read-only native integration
deliverables: Thin read-only MMC/shell adapter prototypes and fixture installation ownership.
acceptance: Retargeting/disconnect cannot redirect to local storage.
Strict portable remains registration-free; fixture teardown preserves foreign registrations.
Real host registration/elevation needs a separate grant; no host changes under the fixture-only task.

units.title: Implement separately admitted image-only formatting
deliverables: One exact format/feature profile on disposable images with reviewed footprint and independent verifier.
acceptance: No physical-device handles or unsupported option substitution.
Interruption/discard/loss/consumer-compatibility cases covered; no format-as-sanitize claim.

units.title: Qualify finite carriers and servicing-owner contracts
deliverables: Pin consumer source and test H/D/S, offline payload equality and ownership on fixture directories.
acceptance: No recursive package/hash construction, silent provider acquisition or competing native owner.
Active/unknown storage dependencies retain exact generations; damaged D has an independent recovery route.
Shipping carrier/channel claims require separate decision acceptance and actual qualification.

units.title: Implement and qualify publication completeness tooling
deliverables: Independent expected staging inventory and safe archive completeness checker.
acceptance: Reject valid-but-empty, missing/extra/duplicate/case-colliding/traversal and changed-byte artifacts.
No archive code is executed by verification; publication and authenticity remain separate.

units.title: Implement bounded interactive shell and descriptor completion
deliverables: Explicit persistent DiskEd shell using the shared typed dispatcher and qualified terminal channels.
Bounded completion/history, canonical aliases, inert paste/editing and readable transcripts.
acceptance: Native fixture tests cover inventory/inspect/propose/review/simulate parity without storage access.
Completion/history never dispatch, probe devices or acquire providers; malformed display data remains escaped.
Linear/monochrome/narrow/redirected channels preserve target and outcome meaning.

Syntax errors preserve editable input and token location; help/completion expose canonical forms and aliases without executing suggestions. Measure successful entry time, corrections and recall across selected keyboards and constrained terminals.
